summary: Examples of deb822_repository: adding a Debian repo, adding one with an inline armored GPG key, and adding a third-party repo with the key fetched from a URL.
questions: How do I add a Docker-style third-party repo with a key URL using deb822?
How do I embed a GPG key inline in a deb822 repo?
What does a basic deb822_repository task look like?

answer_card.title: deb822_repository examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- deb822_repository:
    name: debian
    types: deb
    uris: http://deb.debian.org/debian
    suites: stretch
    components: [main, contrib, non-free]

- deb822_repository:
    name: example
    types: deb
    uris: https://download.example.com/linux/ubuntu
    suites: '{{ ansible_distribution_release }}'
    components: stable
    architectures: amd64
    signed_by: https://download.example.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg
```
`signed_by` can also be an inline `-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----` string.
